checklist.item: Secrets and server texts (tokens, header values, SMTP or upstream replies, file contents) in errors, logs and responses.
checklist.evidence: Errors, logs and responses: no code can emit them. Both commits hold only AGENTS.md, LICENSE and README.md (git ls-tree per commit); cargo build in a copy exits 101 with 'could not find `Cargo.toml`'. Repository content: git grep -n -I -i -E with patterns for GitHub tokens (ghp_, gho_, ghs_, github_pat_), Slack tokens, AWS keys (AKIA...), PEM blocks (-----BEGIN), api_key, secret, token, password, passwd, bearer and PULSE_...= assignments over every blob of both commits: no match, exit 1. The same patterns over refs/pull/1/head: no match, exit 1. grep -P for non-printable or non-ASCII characters over the three files: no match, exit 1.

checklist.item: Authentication before any other check; status codes and their order on admin routes.
checklist.evidence: No code, so no server and no routes. The planned agent only pushes and opens no port on the host (lorenzh/pulse-meta#836, Constraints).

checklist.item: Body and size limits on every method, also before any write.
checklist.evidence: No code: no server that takes a body and no client that reads a response (cargo build exit 101, no Cargo.toml).

checklist.item: Input validation at every trust boundary; validators never throw on any input type.
checklist.evidence: No code: no trust boundary yet (no environment parsing, no /proc or statfs reads, no API response handling).

checklist.item: No accessor or getter of untrusted input runs.
checklist.evidence: No code: no untrusted input is accessed or parsed.

checklist.item: SSRF: allowed targets, environment lookups, redirects (cross-origin, https to http), forwarded headers.
checklist.evidence: No code: no HTTP client and no environment lookups yet. Checks for the planned push client are listed in note N4.
No code that writes files; the planned agent (#836) reads /proc and statfs and sends, and names no file it writes.

checklist.item: Dependencies, Docker base images and CI actions pinned and approved (docs/approved-packages.md).
checklist.evidence: git log --all --name-only lists only AGENTS.md, LICENSE, README.md: no Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, package.json, toolchain file, Dockerfile or .github/ in any commit. gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-agent/actions/workflows --jq .total_count: 0. Releases: 0. Tags: 0. Nothing to pin and nothing unapproved. docs/approved-packages.md has no Rust section (rg -n -i 'rust|cargo|crate' docs/approved-packages.md: no match, exit 1), consistent with the empty crate (note N1).

notes: N1: docs/approved-packages.md has no Rust crate, toolchain pin or Rust CI action; #836 requires a Rust section before the agent adds a crate. The next audit should check Cargo.lock against it and a pinned toolchain.

N2: the pulse-config action policy check (bin/pulse-workflows.js) is invoked through its Bun lint script and reads package.json. Pulse-agent has no package manifest or workflow invoking it. Rust CI must explicitly enforce the approved action pins and persist-credentials: false; the current Bun lint integration does not provide that enforcement in pulse-agent.

N3: gh api .../rulesets gives [] (no ruleset visible to this token); branch protection and required status checks of main could not be verified (command exit 1, HTTP 403, Resource not accessible by integration). Outside the checklist.

N4: checks for the next audit once #836 lands: check secret absent from logs, panics, Debug output and errors also on failed sends; push client refuses redirects (cross-origin, https to http); timeout and response body cap; API URL with user info or non-http(s) scheme refused; /proc, statfs and environment parsers never panic; pinned actions, toolchain and provenance for release builds; systemd unit runs unprivileged with sandbox options.
N5: refs/pull/1/head has the same tree as main (a838256..., git diff --quiet exit 0); no scanned secret pattern matched.
